verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the full memory engine is open source and runs locally or on your own stack. The UI and all pipelines can run on your own machine with no account via `cognee.start_ui()`, and Docker is documented for local deployments. `cognee-cli demo` runs with no API key and no embedding provider on a machine with no network access, which supports the no-cloud-dependency claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring local LLM/embedding models (e.g., Ollama) for real non-demo workloads, details of the embedded in-process graph/vector/relational stores, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.
